items.title: 5.3 Enzyme ke kaam ka tareeqa (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.3, printed pages 129-131.

blocks.text: Kisi kemiyai (chemical) reaction ki raftar (speed) is par munhasir hai ke use shuru karne ke liye kitni activation energy darkar hai. Activation energy woh tawanai (energy) hai jo maujooda kemiyai bonds ko ghair-mustahkam (destabilise) karne ka kaam karti hai. Enzymes reactants ko sahi rukh (orientation) mein ikattha karte hain, ya reactants ke khaas kemiyai bonds par dabao (stress) dalte hain. Is tarah woh naye bonds banne ke liye darkar activation energy kam karte hain aur reaction ki raftar barhate hain, to reactions apni aam raftar se kahin tez chalte hain.

blocks.title: Activation energy
blocks.text: Reactants ke maujooda kemiyai bonds ko ghair-mustahkam karne ke liye darkar tawanai taake reaction shuru ho sake. Enzyme ise kam karta hai; yeh reactants ya products nahin badalta.

blocks.alt: Tawanai (energy) aur reaction ke waqt (reaction time) ka graph. Dono curves reactants ki satah se shuru ho kar neeche products ki satah par khatam hote hain. Surkh curve (bina enzyme) oonchi choti tak jata hai; neela curve (enzyme ke saath) kahin neechi choti tak. Har choti se nuqtedar lakeer hai, aur reactants ki satah se chotiyon tak do-rukhe teer High (Ea) aur Low (Ea) likhe hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Reaction shuru hone ke liye reactants ko tawanai ki ek pahari charhni parti hai; yahi activation energy (Ea) hai. Surkh pahari (bina enzyme) oonchi hai, is liye Ea zyada (High). Neeli pahari (enzyme ke saath) neechi hai, is liye Ea kam (Low) aur reaction tez chalta hai. Dono curves ek hi reactants se shuru aur ek hi products par khatam hote hain: enzyme products ko nahin badalta.

Enzyme ki maujoodgi aakhri products ki fitrat ya khususiyat par asar nahin dalti. Sucrose (substrate) hamesha glucose aur fructose (products) mein hydrolyse hoga, chahe sucrase (enzyme) maujood ho ya na ho.

Apne makhsoos-pan (specificity) ki wajah se enzyme ek makhsoos substrate ko pehchanta hai. Substrate enzyme ke active site se jurta hai, jis se enzyme-substrate complex (ES complex) banta hai aur catalytic site faal ho jata hai. Catalytic site ke atoms substrate ke khaas bonds par dabao dal kar unhen ghair-mustahkam karte hain, to activation energy kam ho jati hai. Yeh amal reaction shuru karta hai aur substrate products mein badal jata hai. Phir enzyme khud ko products se alag kar leta hai, bina badle.

blocks.title: Tareeqa ek line mein
blocks.text: Enzyme + substrate se enzyme-substrate complex banta hai, jis se enzyme + products bante hain. Enzyme bina badle bahar aata hai aur dobara kaam kar sakta hai.

Tanaffus (respiration), photosynthesis aur protein synthesis jaise pecheeda (complex) metabolic raston (pathways) mein bohat se enzymes ek tarteeb se kaam karte hain aur raste ke qadmon ko qaboo karte hain. In qadmon ko qaboo karne wale yake baad deegre enzymes apne cofactors ke saath ikatthe maujood hote hain. Ek enzyme ki catalysis ki paidawar agle qadam ke enzyme ke liye substrate banti hai aur agli paidawar mein badalti hai. Yeh silsila chalta rehta hai yahan tak ke aakhri products bante hain, aur yeh (feedback ke zariye) pehle enzyme ko rokte hain.
Enzyme ke kaam ke tareeqe ke models

1894 mein German chemist Emil Fischer ne lock-and-key model pesh kiya: jaise ek makhsoos chabi sirf ek makhsoos tala khol sakti hai, waise hi ek makhsoos enzyme sirf ek makhsoos substrate ko products mein badal sakta hai. Yeh model farz karta hai ke active site ek sakht (rigid) banawat hai, jis mein enzyme ke kaam se pehle, dauran ya baad mein koi tabdeeli ya lachak nahin.

blocks.alt: Teer se jure chaar marhale ek qatar mein. Enzyme ka block jis ka active site bilkul substrate ki dandi ki shakal ka kata hua hai, aur upar substrate; substrate neeche aa kar fit hota hai aur active site mein koi tabdeeli nahin hoti; substrate site mein betha hua, enzyme-substrate complex; enzyme bina badle, do products alag hote hue. Labels: Substrate, Active site, Enzyme, No change occurs at active site, Enzyme-substrate complex, Products.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.3: Enzyme ke kaam ka lock-and-key model (kitab ki Figure 5.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is model mein active site sakht (rigid) hai: us ki shakal pehle se substrate ke bilkul mutabiq hai, jaise tala aur chabi. Is liye doosre marhale mein likha hai ke active site mein koi tabdeeli nahin hoti. Substrate fit ho kar complex banata hai, products bante hain, aur enzyme apni usi shakal mein dobara kaam ke liye tayyar rehta hai.

Baad ke mutalon ne lock-and-key model ki tamam reactions mein himayat nahin ki. Naye shawahid (evidence) ki bunyad par American biochemist Daniel Koshland (1958) ne induced fit model pesh kiya: jab substrate enzyme ke binding site se milta hai to woh enzyme ki banawat mein tabdeeliyan paida karta hai, aur yeh tabdeeliyan enzyme ko apna catalytic kaam zyada moassar tareeqe se karne deti hain. Yeh model farz karta hai ke active site sakht nahin balke enzyme ke kaam (catalysis) shuru hone se pehle tabdeeli aur lachak ke qabil hai.

blocks.alt: Teer se jure chaar marhale ek qatar mein. Gol enzyme jis ka active site tang darar (slit) jaisa hai aur upar cone jaisa substrate; substrate andar aate hue darar ko chaura karta hai (enzyme ki banawat mein tabdeeli); substrate nai shakal ke shigaf mein poora fit hai (enzyme-substrate complex); products, ek gend aur ek cone, alag hote hain aur darar phir tang ho jati hai (enzyme apni asal banawat wapas pa leta hai).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yahan active site shuru mein substrate ki shakal ka nahin, sirf ek tang darar hai. Substrate jab binding site se milta hai to enzyme ki banawat badalti (induce hoti) hai aur site substrate ke gird theek beth jati hai. Kaam ke baad enzyme phir apni pehli shakal mein aa jata hai. Lock-and-key se farq yahi hai: wahan site sakht hai, yahan lachakdar (flexible).

blocks.prompt: Sucrase sucrose ko glucose aur fructose mein torta hai. Batayen ke enzyme kya badalta hai aur kya nahin, aur samjhayen ke induced fit model lock-and-key se behtar kaise hai.
blocks.explanation: Enzyme activation energy kam karta hai aur yun reaction tez karta hai; yeh products (sucrose se phir bhi glucose aur fructose) ya khud ko nahin badalta. Lock-and-key active site ko sakht manta hai; induced fit kehta hai ke substrate ka jurna enzyme ki shakal badalta hai taake woh substrate ko pakre aur zyada moassar catalyse kare, jis ki baad ke shawahid himayat karte hain.

items: Activation energy maujooda bonds ko ghair-mustahkam karti hai; enzymes reactants ko rukh de kar ya un ke bonds par dabao dal kar ise kam karte hain, to reactions tez chalte hain aur products nahin badalte.

Tareeqa: substrate active site se jur kar enzyme-substrate complex banata hai; catalytic site us ke bonds par dabao dalta hai; products bante hain; enzyme bina badle alag hota hai. Raston mein enzymes tarteeb se kaam karte hain aur aakhri products pehle enzyme par feedback karte hain.
Lock-and-key (Fischer, 1894): sakht active site, ek makhsoos substrate. Induced fit (Koshland, 1958): substrate jurne par site shakal badalta hai, zyada moassar catalysis ke liye.
